Sam: Quick post-all-hands note 26: thanks for the security segment. Can we collect a small list of clarifications for sales/support about SOC2/ISO timelines, BYO KMS expectations, VPC patterns, and audit-log retention?

Isha: Yes. Short answers: SOC2 initial evidence bundle -> mid-June; ISO mapping will need extra artifacts and will follow after initial SOC2 runbook; BYO KMS design in review, aiming for limited beta; audit logs configurable to 365d behind flag.

Jordan: For private connectivity: PrivateLink is our recommended pattern for no-egress; well publish region service names and a terraform module. VPC peering still available but can be slower to set up.

Maggie: ISO note: compliance needs access review exports, KMS policy snapshots, rotation logs. Infra: can you produce redacted samples for the templates?

Alex: Sales asks: can we get a one-pager on BYO KMS limitations (cross-account HSM attestation, latency, SCIM mapping)? That helps during calls.

Isha: Will produce a public FAQ + tech appendix. Draft by 2026-04-30.

Jordan: Tech owner list proposal: BYO KMS beta -> Jordan + Sam -> 2026-05-20. PrivateLink doc -> Jordan -> 2026-05-03. Audit-log retention flag -> Kira + Jordan -> 2026-05-10.

Kira: SOC2 evidence DRI -> Isha + Kira -> 2026-06-15. Will maintain a Confluence page with status and artifacts.

Security-Bot: Auto-scan: 2 infra accounts flagged for missing KMS policy statements. Ticket INFRA-5011 created.

Maggie: For customers using external HSMs with BYO KMS we need an attestation template. Isha, can security draft that?

Isha: Yes 1 will draft customer attestation + internal ingestion checklist by 2026-04-28.

Sam: Let's set a weekly 30m drop-in for compliance questions while we finish the SOC2 bundle. Proposed Tuesdays 9am PT. Jordan, can you schedule?

Jordan: I'll set recurring Tuesdays 9am PT and invite security/legal.

Sam: Action recap (short): SOC2 evidence -> Isha+Kira -> 2026-06-15; BYO KMS beta -> Jordan+Sam -> 2026-05-20; PrivateLink guide -> Jordan -> 2026-05-03; Audit-log retention -> Kira+Jordan -> 2026-05-10; Attestation/checklist -> Isha -> 2026-04-28. Ill compile into a Confluence page.

Alex: Thanks 2thumbsup: will share the one-pager requests from AE team here after this thread.

Kira: Will post Confluence link when ready and keep it updated. Reply here if you need to reassign any DRI.
